heading: PROPITIATORY PRAYERS FOR THE DAY BEFORE NEW YEAR.
body: O Lord God of Hosts, adored by higher beings, thou saidst, Return, ye refractory children, come ye before me with praise and thanksgiving, seek ye my countenance with tears and fervent supplications: though mere lip service remains unanswered, yet to the truly penitent the gates of mercy are open. Thy word is settled for all times, thy kind ways are for ever invariable.
rubrics: Say from “Happy are they,” page 2, till “for it is great,” page 7, after which say the following—
method: Image-only reading from overlapping native-width bands, frozen before opening the same-service existing English readings/XML/OCR in this run. Same-model second pass with prior exposure to earlier encoding and rendered excerpts; not independent-person proofreading. Whitespace and physical line wrapping normalized; typographic detail adjudicated separately.
limitations: Erev lower portion only; opening incidentally visible during seventh-day boundary review. O Lord punctuation and lip service spacing to be checked against close crop after comparison. Opening continues s103.
